goal: Produce a versioned summary artifact from an explicit request.
non_goals: Send the artifact to external systems
compatibility_target: Python 3.9+ and JSON Schema draft 2020-12 documents

must_haves.requirement: Validate an explicit request before generation.
Produce a schema-valid draft summary with source identifiers.
must_haves.acceptance: The positive fixture and manual golden satisfy artifact.schema.json.
Generated output remains draft and no implementation path publishes or approves it.

session_completion.completion_rule: All original must-haves pass their acceptance evidence with no unapproved Scope Delta.
session_completion.continuation_rule: After each slice, continue to the next ready slice while the completion rule is unsatisfied and no human decision or verified blocker prevents progress.
session_completion.scope_delta_policy: Deleting, weakening, deferring, or transferring an original must-have requires explicit human approval before completion.
